packageRules.description: Go toolchain, linter, and go.mod deps move together as one PR per repo.
The go directive + toolchain bump is security-sensitive; keep it its own PR.
Frontend toolchain (React, Vite, Vitest, Biome, Tailwind, TypeScript, types) as one PR.
Pin GitHub Actions to SHAs and group their bumps.
Auto-merge patch, minor, and Action digest bumps once CI is green. CI is the gate: every repo runs lint, tests, build, and govulncheck before a merge can land.
Majors always get a human PR review — they carry migration work (see tcell v3 / bubbletea v2).
